# DeepSeek V4 Guide

> An independent tutorial hub helping developers and beginners access, cost-optimize, and integrate DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, V4 Flash & V4 Pro. All content is researched and sourced; prices and benchmarks are labeled with their as-of date.

## What this site covers

- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: the September 10, 2026 release — Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture, 552B MoE, native vision, 1M context, KV cache compression
- Why V4-Flash was retired and V4-Pro is being routed to V4.1 Flash
- Pricing (peak/off-peak), benchmarks, reasoning effort, API setup, and local deployment
- How to use DeepSeek V4: official API, OpenCode, OpenCode Go, OpenRouter, Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, CC Switch
- Ecosystem news: DeepSeek Harness, V4 Pro GA timeline, comparisons
